summary: Iteration 14 — Frontend-only verification of SoundMap REDESIGN Phase 5 Community Hub at /community. All 7 review scenarios PASS (structure/design). (1) HEADER + TYPOGRAPHY: whisper 'COMUNIDAD' (uppercase via CSS, tracking 0.28em, font-medium, muted), h1 'Gear que la comunidad valida' (data-testid='community-hub-title', 44.8px, fontWeight 500 → matches spec 32-45px / font-medium), muted subheading 'Modelos submitidos por técnicos reales. Votá los que confirmes en campo e importalos a tu sistema con un tap.' (15px, weight 400 → matches spec 12-15px), and 'Proponer gear' CTA (data-testid='community-submit-btn') pinned to the right with Plus icon and white bg. Zero .glass-card, zero ScreenShell/PageHeader legacy chrome inside content wrapper .max-w-4xl. (2) AUTH HINT STRIP: data-testid='community-auth-hint' renders (unauthenticated in preview) with Users icon and exact text 'Iniciá sesión para votar y proponer nuevos modelos.' Quiet blue-tinted background rgba(107,165,199,0.05) with 1px hairline shadow — not a heavy card. (3) FILTER CHIPS: horizontal row present with all 8 test-ids — community-filter-all='Todo', -tops='Tops', -subs='Subs', -monitors='Monitors', -amp='Amps', -dsp='DSP', -mixer='Consolas', -mic='Mics'. Default active is 'Todo' with bg rgb(244,245,247)=#F4F5F7 (white). Clicking 'Tops' switches active state → tops bg becomes rgb(183,140,78)=#B78C4E (CAT_META hue) and 'Todo' becomes rgba(255,255,255,0.03) ghost pill with 1px hairline. All chips use font-medium 12px. (4) STATUS TABS: rounded pill toggle with data-testid='community-status-approved' (default active, bg rgb(255,255,255) white, text #09090b black) and 'community-status-pending' (bg transparent rgba(0,0,0,0)). Clicking Pendiente swaps: approved → transparent, pending → white. Both labels correct in Spanish. (5) LOADING STATE: Convex is offline (VITE_CONVEX_URL unset) so useQuery stays undefined → data-testid='community-loading' spinner renders indefinitely as expected. Spinner class is exactly 'h-6 w-6 border-2 border-white/10 border-t-white/40 rounded-full animate-spin' — a quiet 6x6 border-based ring, not a filled disc. (6) PROPONER MODAL — unauthenticated path: clicking community-submit-btn while unauthenticated does NOT open the modal (submit-gear-overlay absent) and instead fires a Sonner toast with exact text 'Iniciá sesión para proponer gear a la comunidad.' Modal structure verified at source level (src/pages/community-gear/index.tsx L472-656): NUEVO MODELO whisper header, h3 'Proponer gear a la comunidad', close X (data-testid='submit-gear-close'), 7 category chips (data-testid='submit-cat-<key>' for all 7 CAT_META keys tops/subs/monitors/amp/dsp/mixer/mic), 7 TextField inputs (data-testid submit-brand, -model, -spl [required], -rms, -covh, -freq-low, -freq-high), 2 checkboxes (data-testid='submit-active' with accent #5BA777, 'submit-dsp' with accent #9B7EBD), and full-width white submit button (data-testid='submit-gear-btn') gated by canSubmit=!!(form.brand.trim() && form.model.trim() && form.splMax.trim()) at L485-488 (disabled → opacity-40 cursor-not-allowed). Authenticated modal render + form validation live-verified only via code (Convex offline in preview blocks isAuthenticated=true). (7) NO LEGACY VISUAL ARTIFACTS: inside .max-w-4xl content wrapper — .glass-card=0, .font-black=0, .tracking-wider=0. Old subtitle 'Gear submitido por técnicos' absent. No ScreenShell / no PageHeader component. The single .font-black/.tracking-wider found page-wide are on the Emergent floating 'Asesor IA' widget (external shell chrome), not on community content. Zero pageerrors, zero console errors. Design is fully aligned with iteration_11/12/13 (/design, /perform, /compare) — whisper header + big title + muted body + ghost chip filters + quiet CTA + hairline shadows. Spanish throughout. All test-ids kebab-case.
critical_code_review_comments: src/pages/community-gear/index.tsx L46-49: useQuery is called with `status: statusFilter` which is 'approved'|'pending', but the review request lists valid statuses only as those two — good. However the CommunityRow type union on L34 includes 'rejected' which is never surfaced in the UI. If a moderator soft-rejects a submission there is no path for the submitter to see the rejection reason. Consider either a third status tab or a submitter-only 'Mis propuestas' view.

src/pages/community-gear/index.tsx L189-204: the empty-state test-id='community-empty' renders when rows.length===0 — this is only reachable when Convex resolves. In preview (Convex offline) we can't verify empty state (spinner stays forever). Consider adding a URL param `?mock=empty` or `?mock=populated` for developer/QA verification of hero + list + empty branches without a live Convex.

src/pages/community-gear/index.tsx L246-252 and L379-385: HeroGear.handleUpvote and CommunityListRow.handleUpvote optimistically flip `voted=true` before the mutation resolves; on error they revert. But the displayed count `row.upvotes + (voted ? 1 : 0)` (L330, L450) means if the server auto-refreshes the query with the new upvote reflected, the row.upvotes count will already include this user's vote AND `voted` will still be true → +2 visual increment for one click until next render. In practice React re-renders should reconcile this, but consider making the +1 conditional on `voted && !alreadyCounted` or letting the Convex reactive query be the sole source of truth.

src/pages/community-gear/index.tsx L254-267 and L387-400: handleImport for HeroGear/CommunityListRow blindly appends to `tops` or `subs` arrays. There is no dedupe — importing the same community model twice creates two identical entries. Consider dedupe by (brand, model) or a subtle 'Ya en tu gear' state on the Import button.

src/pages/community-gear/index.tsx L490-515: handleSubmit sets busy=true then calls the mutation, but there is no explicit timeout / cancellation. If Convex hangs the modal stays in 'Enviando…' forever with the close X still functional but no visible progress hint. Consider a 15s timeout that setError('Tiempo agotado, intentá de nuevo.').

Positive observation — /community mirrors /design, /perform, /compare (iteration_11/12/13) 1:1: whisper 'COMUNIDAD' + h1 44.8px font-medium + muted 15px body + ghost chips + rounded pill status tabs + quiet 6x6 border spinner + hairline 1px shadows in place of GlassCard. Spanish tone and copy are on-brand ('Iniciá sesión…', 'Modelos submitidos por técnicos reales', 'Sé el primero en proponer un modelo'). The Community Hub Phase 5 redesign is production-ready pending live Convex verification of the hero + list + submit-mutation branches.
